source.excerpt:
cells the ledger itself called un-measured at power.** The seal **failed at its own frozen bar**
— so HIT auto-certification is withheld and every bar-clearing survivor from this round onward is
*flagged-for-oracle*, never auto-certified. The compute lanes that did run came back **clean at a
stated fraction with power 1.00**, and one instrument lane produced the single number two previous

assumptions: Planted hallucinations and genuine controls approximate future failure modes

tested_scope.T1: Source and existing-record inspection only; no research rerun.
tested_scope.reported_or_source_scope: R20 real-mode caught 15/45; R21 best genuine-safe catch .80 below .90, fresh surrogate false-reject .167 above .10.

inherited_ledger_bounds.coverage: Full pre-registered proxy-parameter grid: k in {2,3,4,5,6} x rule in {min, mean, frac_pass} = 15/15 cells, each scored for catch on the frozen planted-45 EN_NOVOWEL hallucination population AND genuine false-reject on a 20-case correct-key EN_MODERN panel. Winning cell (k=5/min) then FROZEN and audited on a DISJOINT held-out surrogate (fresh key seed CICADA3301, disjoint rng offsets): 66 hallucinations + 24 genuine. Conditionals held fixed: key space = correct key (hardest case); decoder relation = exact preset; adjudicator register = EN_NOVOWEL argmax. Language-agnostic held-out recovery (rune-index self-consistency, no plaintext oracle, no English LM) persisted per cell in catch_surface.json (doctrine R3).
inherited_ledger_bounds.not_covered: NC-1 keyskip1-relation catch: the planted 45 are exact-preset overfits; Q4 named the keyskip1 relation axis but this lane did not populate a keyskip1 hallucination population, so catch along that axis is unmeasured. NC-2 registers other than EN_NOVOWEL: catch on Latin/Welsh/OE-register hallucinations not measured (EN_NOVOWEL is the FOUND-ERROR's register). NC-3 non-fold proxy families: a longer decrypt head than the 24-32 rune head that capped R20 P1's hard registers, a per-register fold bar, or a learned self-consistency gate could still reach 0.90; the disjoint-fold family alone is bounded here at 0.818 (genuine-safe, held-out) to 0.867 (genuine-unsafe ceiling). NC-4 the seal is a proxy-power bound, not a claim that any specific LP2 candidate is or is not a solve.

inherited_ledger_bounds.coverage: The gate every sweep from Round 20's Phase S onward routes through: R20 S-G3 / S-RESCOPE, R21 L3, R22 C, R24 C2 / C2-EXT, R25 compute-tail.

It caught 15/45 (33%) EN_NOVOWEL hallucinations at ship time (found by R20 S-RESCOPE's audit, SYNTHESIS 8.4); the disjoint-fold strengthening attempted in R21-L1 reached only 0.80 and was KILLED. See R21-L1-SEAL.
EN_NOVOWEL clears the bar at recovery 0.84 (exact) / 0.26 (drift), both < 0.90, so that register is detection-only.
